use_cases: AI-powered web search input with auto-resizing text area
Chat-style input interfaces for AI assistants
Modern search bars with focus state animations
Command-style input fields in SaaS applications
Interactive search containers with accessibility support
ai_summary: A polished AI search input component featuring an auto-resizing textarea, focus state animations, and keyboard navigation support. Includes Lucide icons for search, globe, and attachment, with dark mode compatibility. Designed for seamless integration into AI-powered SaaS applications, providing an intuitive and accessible search experience across desktop and mobile platforms.
